description: List the metadata for all uploaded data files.

FileResponse.description: Structured information describing a file uploaded to Together.

FileType.description: The type of the file such as `jsonl`, `csv`, or `parquet`.

Processed.description: Deprecated. Whether file has been fully uploaded.

bytes.description: The number of bytes in the file.

created_at.description: The timestamp when the file was created.

filename.description: The name of the file as it was uploaded.

object.description: The object type, which is always `file`.

processing_status.description:
Lifecycle state of the file validation pipeline. Files for
non-`fine-tune` purposes skip validation.

purpose.description: The purpose of the file as it was uploaded.

validation_report.description:
Report produced by the file validation pipeline. Present once
validation has run; absent on files that bypassed validation
(non-`fine-tune` purposes) or have not yet been validated.

FileProcessingStatus.description:
Lifecycle state of a file in the validation pipeline. The typical
progression is `PENDING` → `QUEUED` → `RUNNING` → `COMPLETED` /
`FAILED`. `INVALID_FORMAT` is a terminal state for files whose
contents failed validation in a user-correctable way.

FileValidationReport.description:
Validation outcome for a fine-tune training file, produced by the
file validation pipeline.

dataset_has_message_weights.description: Whether the dataset carries per-message weights (only possible for `CONVERSATION` format).

dataset_has_parallel_tool_calls.description: Whether the dataset contains parallel tool-use messages.

dataset_has_reasoning.description: Whether the dataset contains reasoning content.

dataset_has_sample_weights.description: Whether the dataset carries per-sample weights.

dataset_has_tools.description: Whether the dataset contains tool-use messages.

dataset_is_multimodal.description: Whether the dataset contains multimodal content.

error.description:
Human-readable validation error message. Only present when
`error_type` is set (i.e. user-correctable failures).

file_id.description: ID of the file this report describes.

nlines.description: Number of lines (records) in the dataset.
